title: Evening Dispatch Sol 13
headline: Evening Dispatch
anchor_intro: Good evening, Enclave. The Hearth galley is sweltering tonight, thick with the scent of caramelized root-starches and the metallic tang of ionized ozone leaking from the vents. The low rumble of the ferrofluid sea outside vibrates up through the copper decking, a steady thrum we feel deep in our ribs. We must DEFEND the delicate souffles from the barometric pressure drops, CONCEAL the remaining sugar rations before the night shift finds them, and ATTRACT the ambient heat into the secondary thermal coils.
broadcast_script: Ryn wipes her hands on her linen apron and taps the brass microphone. 'The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is peaking out there. If you don't calculate the thermal gradients correctly, you're going to freeze the turbine lubricants, and then we're eating raw protein paste for a month. We have to fail forward—if the primary seals rupture, channel the ambient freeze into the cold-storage units to save the harvest. Why? Because the seals are old. Why are they old? Because we haven't found fresh polymers. Why? Because the storm hasn't let up.' She physically hands the heavy baton to Silas, her knuckles brushing his. 'Your turn, Silas. Don't let the broth boil over.'

# Evening Dispatch

Ryn hands the mic to Silas.
